title: AI multilingual translation
configured: Connection is configured. Review translations before applying.
not_configured: Provider, model or API key is not configured. Check connection status in settings and ask your server administrator to configure it.
settings: Shop settings → Language/Currency → AI connection status
instructions: Translate Korean source into selected languages. Fill empty translations by default. Review, apply to this form, then use the existing Save button. Empty sources are skipped.
seo_sync: SEO fields with automatic sync are not translated separately; they follow translated names/descriptions when saved. Turn off sync in the existing SEO settings for custom copy.
terms: Preserve brands, proper names and specifications (one per line)
retry: Retry failed items only (up to 3 attempts)
limits: Select languages and fields. A request supports up to 200 language-specific items; split larger selections.

errors.timeout: Time limit exceeded. Check the status before retrying the required items.
errors.provider_failed: Connection or translation failed. Input is preserved.
errors.invalid_response: Response format, identifier or preserved-text validation failed.
